item.title: Miyagi Power Spots: Zuiganji Temple, Osaki Hachimangu & Shiogama's Sacred Shore
item.description: Miyagi Prefecture Spiritual Power Spots Guide Miyagi Prefecture, home to the legendary Date Masamune and gateway to Tohoku’s spiritual heartland, offers international visitors an extraordinary collection of sacred sites where centuries of devotion have created palpable spiritual atmospheres. From meditation caves carved into cliffs over a thousand years ago to sacred island landscapes that have inspired poets for generations, these power spots combine natural beauty with deep historical resonance. 1. Zuiganji Temple (瑞巌寺) — The Meditation Caves of Matsushima Spiritual Energy: Protection, willpower, martial discipline, ancient Buddhist presence
